nodes.label: Disposable upload-to-invoice journey
nodes.rationale: The complete application journey passes against a disposable local database: sign in, upload a new Excel file, confirm its recurring format, review the order, confirm purchasing, generate and finalize packing, open a printable invoice, scan the finalized sticker, view the exact locked box, and sign out. This is verification of the current local implementation. It does not certify a deployed release or approve the contents of any real customer order. The original customer records were not advanced to purchasing, packing, or billing.
